knowledge.title: PCOS Knowledge & Stigma-Free Guidance
knowledge.prevalenceStat: PCOS affects approximately 1 in 5 (20%) women of reproductive age in India, and 8-13% globally. (PLACEHOLDER: needs clinical review)
knowledge.confidenceQuote1: Your body is not broken. It is communicating with you.
knowledge.confidenceQuote2: PCOS does not define your worth, femininity, or future.
knowledge.confidenceQuote3: Progress is made in gentle, patient daily choices, not restrictive extremes.
knowledge.myth1: Myth: PCOS means you can never have children.
knowledge.fact1: Fact: With medical guidance, ovulation support, and lifestyle care, many people with PCOS conceive safely.
knowledge.myth2: Myth: You must follow an extreme, restrictive diet to manage PCOS.
knowledge.fact2: Fact: Balanced nutrition with adequate protein, fiber, and steady blood sugar works far better than extreme deprivation.
knowledge.myth3: Myth: PCOS only affects people who are overweight.
knowledge.fact3: Fact: 'Lean PCOS' is well documented. PCOS is a complex hormonal and metabolic condition that presents across all body types.
knowledge.affirmationText: I honor my body's rhythm today. I listen with curiosity and compassion.
knowledge.reviewedBy: Reviewed by Dr. Ananya Rao, MD (OB/GYN) - PLACEHOLDER: needs clinical review
